name: Endurance Mode: Open + Persistent
author: AnlionGamer
description: Makes normal Endurance operate as an open, persistent world without changing Endurance gameplay: late joining remains available, vanilla saved-world selection is exposed, persistent-mode terrain flushing is used, and EndGame no longer automatically deletes the active normal-Endurance world. Returning players continue to use CastleMiner Z's vanilla per-world inventory protocol.
license: Community test build; non-commercial redistribution only with author permission.
releaseNotes: v1.2.1: Formal display-name/internal-branding rename plus builder identity/version hardening. Retains the v1.2.0 persistence pass: normal Endurance uses persistent-mode terrain flushing and its active world is protected from EndGame automatic deletion. v1.0.0 late joining and v1.1.0 vanilla world selection remain intact. Vanilla host/guest .inv persistence is preserved; Endurance gameplay and difficulty remain unchanged.
multiplayer: Host-side mod. Joining players are expected to remain vanilla-compatible because player inventory retrieval/storage uses CastleMiner Z's existing RequestInventory / InventoryRetrieveFromServer / InventoryStoreOnServer protocol. Persistent returning-player behavior still requires runtime multiplayer verification.
